properties.title: OOI CHLA profile metrics (0–200 m, 10 m bins)
properties.description:
CHLA metrics from OOI profilers and moorings (Mar 2024–Oct 2026), one row per instrument and 3 h window of local solar time, depth-binned 0–200 m in 10 m bins (A < depth <= B, as for Argo) from samples with qc_agg = 1, using true depths for fixed-depth instruments, and divided by the Sauzède et al. fluorescence:chlorophyll ratio for the site (column chla_ratio). Time is the mean time of the window's samples. Source: OOI ERDDAP.

How to load

ASSET_URL use 'Copy URL' on left

Python df = pandas.read_parquet('ASSET_URL')

R  df <- arrow::read_parquet('ASSET_URL')
